name: Wickerwork
description: Wide strips one way and narrow ones the other, in two inks.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: var(--color1); -webkit-mask: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, #000 0 20%, transparent 20% 33.34%); mask: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, #000 0 20%, transparent 20% 33.34%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 8%, transparent 8% 16.67%); mask: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 8%, transparent 8% 16.67%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
